payload.title: Primus: reconnect Amplify app to renamed repo
payload.description:
PRIMUS Amplify app divicqm3nhcwt (legacy account 335163751677, profile legacy, us-east-1).
STATE: primus.anth.us shows the "Early access" chip (verified live 2026-10-19 12:29Z); a main build succeeded 07:17 ET. The app still points at the pre-rename repo name (Plexus), so pushes to main do not trigger builds. Repo was renamed (Plexus -> Primus).
TODO: Ryan reconnects the repository in the Amplify console (needs his GitHub sign-in; CLI update-app needs --access-token and was blocked by the Mac permission check), or approve `aws amplify update-app --app-id divicqm3nhcwt --repository https://github.com/AnthusAI/Primus --access-token "$(gh auth token)"` with AWS_PROFILE=legacy. Then confirm a push to main triggers a build. Do not start extra builds without checking list-jobs first.
